# Support

Need help with Hey Frank? You've come to the right place!

## 📚 Documentation

Before asking for help, check if your question is answered in our documentation:

- **[README](../README.md)** - Project overview and features
- **[Quick Start Guide](../docs/quickstart.md)** - Get started in 5 minutes
- **[Installation Guide](../docs/installation.md)** - Detailed installation instructions
- **[User Manual](../docs/user-guide.md)** - Complete feature documentation
- **[Troubleshooting Guide](../docs/troubleshooting.md)** - Common issues and solutions
- **[FAQ](../docs/faq.md)** - Frequently asked questions

## 🐛 Found a Bug?

If you've found a bug, please:

1. **Search existing issues** - Your bug might already be reported
   - [Open Issues](https://github.com/Samarthjadhavsj/API-AI-Assistant/issues)
   - [Closed Issues](https://github.com/Samarthjadhavsj/API-AI-Assistant/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed)

2. **Create a detailed bug report**
   - Use our [Bug Report Template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml)
   - Include steps to reproduce
   - Attach logs if possible
   - Specify your OS and version

3. **Be patient and respectful**
   - Maintainers are volunteers
   - We'll respond as soon as possible

## 💡 Have a Feature Request?

We love hearing your ideas!

1. **Check if it's already requested**
   - [Feature Requests](https://github.com/Samarthjadhavsj/API-AI-Assistant/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement)

2. **Create a feature request**
   - Use our [Feature Request Template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml)
   - Explain your use case
   - Describe the expected behavior
   - Include mockups if applicable

3. **Contribute!**
   - Want to implement it yourself? See our [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

## ❓ Have a Question?

### For General Questions

Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Samarthjadhavsj/API-AI-Assistant/discussions):

- **Q&A** - Ask questions and get answers
- **Ideas** - Discuss features and improvements
- **Show and Tell** - Share your setups and workflows
- **General** - Anything else related to Hey Frank

### For Security Issues

**Do NOT open a public issue!**

Report security vulnerabilities privately:
- See our [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md)
- Email: samarthjadhavsj121@gmail.com

## ⚠️ Important Notes

**Response Times:**
- This is an open-source project maintained by volunteers
- Response times may vary based on maintainer availability
- Critical security issues receive priority attention

**What We Can Help With:**
- ✅ Bug reports and technical issues
- ✅ Feature discussions and ideas
- ✅ Documentation improvements
- ✅ Setup and configuration help

**What We Can't Help With:**
- ❌ Custom development for your specific needs
- ❌ Paid support (not available yet)
- ❌ AI provider account issues (contact them directly)
- ❌ General AI or programming tutorials
